title: 🔥宏观流动性紧锁压制反弹
body: 市场处于宏观流动性紧锁的防御阶段。BMRI录得77，处于RISK_OFF区间，显示当前风险偏好极度低迷。虽然油价下跌可能重燃降息预期，但在流动性指标未转向前，市场缺乏反转的宏观动力。外部环境不改善，内部反弹难持续。偏空。宏观靴子落地了吗？
body_en: The market is in a defensive phase with macro liquidity locked down. BMRI hits 77, deep in the RISK_OFF zone, signaling that risk sentiment is rock bottom. While falling oil prices might reignite rate-cut hopes, until liquidity indicators pivot, the market lacks the macro momentum for a reversal. If the external environment doesn't improve, internal bounces won't sustain. Leaning bearish. Have the macro boots dropped yet?
